verdict.rationale: CAM has a dedicated IP practice group page. It describes a team of lawyers and engineers handling IP matters that cover patented and unpatented technology, so a documented group page touching patents exists. The evidence never explicitly mentions drafting or filing patent applications, prosecution before the patent office, or portfolio strategy, and names no practitioners. Missing for 10: explicit patent drafting/filing/prosecution services, portfolio strategy or defensibility work, named patent practitioners, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Our industry-leading IP team, comprising highly-skilled lawyers and engineers with proven track records, specialises in providing innovative and effective legal solutions across a wide spectrum of IP-related matters
Patented and unpatented technology, trademarks, copyright and designs
